name: Date Fright
source:
Halloween comes once a year, and you and your best friend Cerise are determined to make the most of it. After leaving a boring Halloween mixer with your dates in tow, you’re determined to do something that feels quintessentially Halloween-like:

Visiting a long-abandoned mansion. What awaits you all as you enter the door to a grand estate in the middle of the night? True love? An adventure of a lifetime? Or something more sinister?

[From [url=https://deepfriedghost.itch.io/date-fright]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
万圣节一年只有一次，你和挚友瑟莉丝下定决心要尽情狂欢一场。带着各自的约会对象离开沉闷无聊的万圣节联谊会后，你们决定去干一件最具万圣节仪式感的事：

夜探一栋荒废已久的古老宅邸。当你们在午夜时分推开这座宏伟庄园的大门，门后等待着众人的究竟是什么？是真挚的恋情？是毕生难忘的奇遇？还是某种更加阴森险恶的存在？

[摘自[url=https://deepfriedghost.itch.io/date-fright]itch.io[/url]]
